parameter: EIA 2.3 Water: residual oxidant (as Cl2) at the outfall at most 0.1 mg/l
remarks: ALP-EPC-00PBA-PR-SDS-0001 (electro-chlorination SDD); ALP-EPC-00PBA-ME-CAL-0001; ALP-EPC-00PBA-ME-SPC-0001; TRO analysers at the condenser outlet and the seal pit (ALP-EPC-00PAA-IC-DSH-0001). Status preliminary until the SDD is issued.
value_text: Seawater electro-chlorination per DEC-EPCE-0015: continuous low-level dosing at the intake with pulse dosing; residual oxidant measured at the condenser outlet and at the outfall seal pit, dosing controlled on the seal-pit value with set-point 0.08 mg/l and alarm at the limit DP-CASE-0017; the compliance point is the end of the outfall pipe, sampled at the seal pit, no mixing zone credited (TQ-041); no dechlorination.
